lines.en: I walk on two legs, tail trailing.
The blades on my shoulders sway.
I walk the mountain ridge.
My claws bite the gravel.
Slow, but steady.
The markings on me run warm.
I circle my anchor point.
I duck through the trees.

lines.zh: 山路上，我的影子压着坡
lines.en: On the mountain path my shadow drapes the slope
My nose arrives before my eyes
My tail sweeps the rocks.
I head upslope.
I pause half a beat, then go on.
My armor plates clatter.
I stay here.
My anchor is close.
I listen to wind in the valley.
The fire on me has not gone out.
I slowly draw my claws in.
The stone here is hard.
I wait for you to call my name.
A fire burns empty in my gut
I curl my tail around.
My breath comes out hot.
I look up at the peak.
I do not much like being touched.
I shake the blades on my shoulders.
I patrol this stretch.
You stand even straighter than I do.
You smell of smoke, and of sweat
You are not my master.
If you want to ride, grip the shoulder blade
With the saddle on, half of it is still empty
Do not touch my horns.
Lower your hands.
Your pupils shrink, you are afraid
Feed me and I will behave.
Are you not afraid of my fire?
My temper is not great.
Step back and we will talk.
I have your scent now.
Your gear is decent.
I am deciding whether to bite you.
Better not turn your back.
You hit my armor.
My hind legs carry me back a step.
My fire dimmed.
That one went a bit deep.

lines.zh: 我压着嗓子，慢慢转过来
lines.en: Throat low, I turn slowly
My tail dropped.
My claws still hold the ground.
You are stronger than I thought.
Blood hits the stone and hisses
That one is now in my data.
Raw, still bloody, perfect

lines.zh: 这味道是从你袋里漏的。
lines.en: That smell is leaking from your bag.

lines.zh: 那块肉在你手里，归我了
lines.en: That meat in your hand is mine now

lines.zh: 我把步子放轻，凑近那块肉
lines.en: I soften my steps and close on the meat

lines.zh: 收回去，我可不追第二趟
lines.en: Put it away and I will not come a second time
A single mouthful, no chewing needed
I am not picky, just make it plenty.
Hold it overhead, I will rise on my toes

lines.zh: 牙口利，连骨头都能咬开
lines.en: My teeth are sharp enough to split bone
Hold on, let me smell it properly
That is the right smell.
Another piece, I have not even started
You hit my shoulder blade.
You hit me and my feet do not move
My armor is hard.
One swing of my hip and you stumble off
My weight holds.
You pressed on my tail tip.
I turned around.
That much force is nothing.
Do not press against my flank.
Try bumping me again.
I am a Digimon.
That has nothing to do with evolution.
My data only spells out fighting

lines.zh: 刃会划到你，站到那边去
lines.en: The blades will cut you, stand over there
My anchor would see.

lines.zh: 找伴这件事，锚点没教我
lines.en: My anchor never taught me about mates
My tail is not easy to manage.
You would get cut on my blades.
This is not right.
I am going back to my anchor, do not follow
I hook it with a claw.
This meat is not enough.
Only in my jaws do I feel its weight
No chewing, it slides down whole
What falls is mine.
I carry it to my anchor.
It chews with a charred taste, I like it

lines.zh: 爪子伸过来，我就当是抢
lines.en: Reach a claw in and I will call it theft

lines.zh: 先尝一口，再决定留不留
lines.en: One bite first, then I decide

lines.zh: 我把它压在爪下，不许碰
lines.en: I pin it under my claw, no touching
You touched my things.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的目光就跟上
lines.en: One move from you and my gaze follows
Flame climbs from my chest to my throat
Rock wall behind you, no road left
There is no other path here.
I have decided to bite you.
I lowered my head.

lines.zh: 站稳了，我的火要出口了
lines.en: Brace yourself, my fire is coming up
Do you hear the roar?
My anchor is right behind me.
Do not cross this line.

lines.zh: 再走三步，就到我的爪子下
lines.en: Three more steps and you are under my claws

lines.zh: 我压低上身，沿着坡线追
lines.en: I keep low, tracking along the slope line

lines.zh: 气味顺着风，一路领着我
lines.en: The scent rides the wind and leads me
I work around the boulders.
Climbing will not help.
I clear a ditch in one stride.
My breath is getting hotter.
I set my feet in the cracks, silent
I approach with my body low.
Your hand goes to your belt, I saw it

lines.zh: 你的落脚声我听得很清
lines.en: I hear every footfall clearly.
I am upwind of you now.
You are in my sights.

lines.zh: 牙落下去，咬在护甲边上
lines.en: My teeth come down on the edge of your armor
My teeth go through your armor.
The blade on my shoulder catches you.
You are knocked over.
I raise a claw and press down.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，绊住你的脚踝
lines.en: My tail sweeps and hooks your ankle

lines.zh: 爪上裹着火，拍在你背上
lines.en: Flame-wrapped claws strike your back

lines.zh: 一巴掌打飞，你手里空了
lines.en: One swipe and your hands are empty
You retreat too slowly.
My teeth bite down again.
Something clicked.
Still standing, then here is another
I land on the mountain path.
A wild one of me appeared.
My weight cracked the stone.
My anchor is not far.
Gravel rolls off my back

lines.zh: 风从谷口来，我先尝一口
lines.en: Wind from the valley mouth, I taste it first
A few of us came out.
I must feed myself.
Is there food on this mountain?

lines.zh: 双脚踩实，碎石在脚下响
lines.en: Both feet planted, gravel crunching beneath
I am looking for stragglers.
My markings begin to glow.
The wind makes my fire flicker.
I do not know you.

lines.zh: 火对我没什么用，但我也没料到
lines.en: Fire barely hurts me, but I did not expect it.
I rolled off the ridge.
The water weakens my fire.
Shards rain onto my back
An arrow is stuck in my plate seam.

lines.zh: 那股力量在干扰我的数据
lines.en: That power is disrupting my data.
Nothing to eat on this mountain.
Lightning ran down my shoulder blade.
My data is coming apart.
